extracted.name: Feta Chicken Salad
extracted.description: This feta chicken salad is a basic chicken salad recipe with red bell peppers and feta cheese. Try using tomato-basil feta for added flavor!
ingredient_lines: 1 medium red bell pepper, seeded and diced
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Mix chicken, celery, and red onion together in a serving bowl.
Stir mayonnaise, sour cream, feta cheese, and dill together in a separate bowl. Pour over chicken mixture, and stir to blend. Taste, and season with salt and pepper as needed.
Serve immediately, or refrigerate until serving.
